newsitem.title: USA: Glenayre Technologies wins China contract.
newsitem.headline: Glenayre Technologies wins China contract.

text.p: Glenayre Technologies Inc said on Tuesday that it signed a $5.5 million contract with Hebei Provincial Posts and Telecommunications Administration to supply 280 MHz high speed paging infrastructure in China.
The infrastructure would be for a new network that would provide service to 10 cities in the Chinese province of Hebei.

Hebei's system would be the first provincial network to be included in China's nationwide high speed paging backbone network. Glenayre said it is a major system provider of this network, set to be in service by the first quarter 1997.
The contract included installation of Glenayre's GL3000 Wireless Messaging Switches, GL-T8000 series transmitters, GL-C2000 Controllers and networking equipment, it said.
